founded_year.quote: The Johannesburg Stock Exchange (the JSE) was founded by Benjamin Wollan on 8 November 1887. Johannesburg Chambers and Company (Benjamin's company) was the first company to list.

history.zh: 1947年《证券交易所管制法》立法；1963年加入世界交易所联合会（WFE）；1996年电子化交易系统上线、场内公开喊价交易大厅关闭；1997年电子清算结算机构Strate成立；2001年收购南非期货交易所（SAFEX），获得金融衍生品交易能力；2003年设立AltX（中小企业板）；2005年改制为公司制并在自身运营的交易所挂牌上市，成为JSE Limited；2009年收购南非债券交易所（BESA）；2012年现货市场迁移至新交易平台Millennium Exchange；2014年开设托管中心（colocation）；2016年结算周期从T+5缩短至T+3；2019年权益及货币衍生品迁移至Millennium Exchange平台
history.en: 1947 Stock Exchange Control Act promulgated; 1963 joined the World Federation of Exchanges (WFE); 1996 electronic trading system launched and the open outcry trading floor closed; 1997 Strate (electronic clearing and settlement) established; 2001 acquired the South African Futures Exchange (SAFEX); 2003 launched AltX; 2005 demutualised and self-listed as JSE Limited; 2009 acquired the Bond Exchange of South Africa (BESA); 2012 equity market moved to the Millennium Exchange trading platform; 2014 opened a colocation centre; 2016 moved to T+3 settlement; 2019 equity and currency derivatives migrated to Millennium Exchange

regulator.en: Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) — the market-conduct regulator under South Africa's Twin Peaks framework
regulator.detail: 常识背景：FSCA由原金融服务局（FSB）于2018年改制而来，但本次未在fsca.co.za抓取到直接摘引"2018"这一年份的原文段落（quote 只确认了机构现有职能表述），故zh/en正文不写入该年份数字，避免与quote反查不上；这一沿革事实作为背景写在这里而非正文。南非另设审慎监管局（Prudential Authority，隶属南非储备银行SARB）负责金融机构的审慎监管，与FSCA构成「双峰」分工；清算类系统重要性基础设施（如JSE Clear）的牌照审批由FSCA会同PA/SARB联合作出，见 clearing_regulator。

sources.title: About Us（fsca.co.za）

regulator.quote: The Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) regulates and supervises the market conduct of financial institutions in South Africa. The mandate of the FSCA is to enhance and support the efficiency and integrity of the financial system, and to protect financial customers.

self_regulatory_org.zh: JSE自身兼具前线监管职能：设Issuer Regulation（发行人监管）与Market Regulation（市场监管）两个内部部门，负责上市审核、持续监管、成员合规与市场纪律，重大规则修订与授权则需FMA框架下向FSCA备案/批准
self_regulatory_org.en: The JSE itself performs front-line regulation via its internal Issuer Regulation and Market Regulation divisions (listing review, continuing obligations, member compliance and market discipline), with major rule changes and authorisations subject to FSCA oversight under the FMA
self_regulatory_org.detail: 本条为综合多份JSE官方文档（上市规则"the JSE will grant a listing"式表述、Market Regulation Division负责会员资本充足监控的表述）的归纳性描述，非单一原文段落的逐字摘引，quote 摘自其中一处最具代表性的段落。

matching_principle.zh: 中央订单簿按价格-可见性-时间优先原则连续撮合：会员在同等条件下竞争成交，同价位隐藏单排在可见单之后成交
matching_principle.en: Central order book matching on strict price-visibility-time priority; members compete on equal terms, with hidden orders yielding priority to visible orders at the same price

sources.title: Volume 00E – Trading and Information Overview（8.6.1 Central Order Book）

matching_principle.quote: The central order book is an order-matching facility where members participate on equal terms, competing for execution on the basis of strict price-visibility-time priority. Any hidden order at a better price will take priority and visible orders will take priority over hidden orders if they are placed at the same price.

order_types.quote: Limit order An order where the number of shares and price is specified. ... Market Order Is an order where no limit price is specified and only the volume of shares to be executed is specified ... Iceberg Order Identifies an order that is partially visible to the market.

type.zh: 双阈值百分比机制：以前收盘价为基准的静态参考价（Static Reference Price）与以最新成交价动态更新的动态参考价（Dynamic Reference Price）各设独立的百分比容忍阈值，任一阈值被突破即触发波动性拍卖（不是直接拒单的固定涨跌停）
type.en: Dual percentage-band mechanism: independent tolerance percentages are set against a Static Reference Price (previous close, updated after each auction) and a Dynamic Reference Price (last traded price); breaching either triggers a Volatility Auction rather than an outright order rejection

sources.title: Volume 00E – Trading and Information Overview（8.5/8.6.5）

type.quote: Circuit breaker tolerance is defined as a percentage in relation to the Static Reference Price and / or Dynamic Reference Price. If the difference between the price of the next trade and the Static Reference Price or Dynamic Reference Price is equal or greater than that permitted by the circuit breaker tolerance defined for the relevant session the instrument will automatically be moved into a Volatility Auction Call session.

main_board.en: For Segment ZA01 (Top40 constituents and other highly liquid instruments): Continuous Trading Static ±10% / Dynamic ±3%; Opening/Closing/Re-Opening Auction Calls Static ±8% / Dynamic ±6%; Futures Close-Out Auction Call Static ±15% / Dynamic ±2%

other_boards.quote: Circuit breakers are only enabled for Segments ZA01 and ZA02, as follows: ... ZA02 ... Continuous Trading 15% 5%

circuit_breaker.zh: 个股/品种级熔断（非指数级）：静态或动态参考价容忍阈值被突破后，该品种自动转入5分钟的波动性拍卖冷静期（Volatility Auction Call），非全市场停牌。未找到与美股MWCB或港交所整体停市式的独立全市场级熔断机制，与jp-jpx/de-eurex此前遇到的同类未确认情况类似，不确定是否本次检索范围局限
circuit_breaker.en: Instrument-level circuit breaker (not index-level): breaching the static or dynamic reference-price tolerance moves the instrument into a 5-minute Volatility Auction Call, not an exchange-wide halt. No evidence of a separate market-wide circuit breaker (akin to U.S. MWCB) was found in the content fetched this round — similar to the unresolved status previously noted for jp-jpx/de-eurex, this may reflect the limits of this session's search rather than a confirmed absence

sources.title: SUMMARY OF JSE CIRCUIT BREAKERS AND AUCTIONS（Service Hotline 062/2020 PDF）

circuit_breaker.quote: Circuit Breakers are defined as a percentage in relation to the Static Reference Price (Previous Day's closing price or latest auction trade) and Dynamic Reference Price (Last Traded Price). If the Static or Dynamic circuit breaker for the relevant trading session is breached, the instrument will automatically be moved into a Volatility Auction Call session.

volatility_interruption.zh: 波动性拍卖冷静期（Volatility Auction Call Session）：持续5分钟，可能追加1次2分钟的市价单延期（Market Order Extension），随后进入最长30秒的随机撮合窗口完成集合竞价定价
volatility_interruption.en: Volatility Auction Call Session: lasts 5 minutes, may be followed by one 2-minute Market Order Extension, then a random period of up to 30 seconds before the auction uncrossing

sources.title: Equity Market_Trading & Information System_Conceptual Training_v2

volatility_interruption.quote: This session lasts for 5 minutes and may be followed by one Market Order Extension of 2 minutes. This will be followed by a random period of up to 30 seconds when the uncrossing occurs.

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 人工停牌（Halt Session）：由JSE市场运营人员手动触发，可针对全市场/交易分段/单一品种；恢复交易通过手动触发的重开集合竞价（Re-Opening Auction Call Session）完成
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Manually invoked Halt Session, triggered by JSE Market Operations at the market/segment/instrument level; resumption is via a manually invoked Re-Opening Auction Call Session

sources.title: Volume 00E – Trading and Information Overview（8.4.14/8.4.17）

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: This session will be manually triggered by Market Operations Users. A halt may be triggered for the Market, Segment or Instrument.

intraday_reversal.detail: 本次抓取的交易规程文本未直接给出"当日买入证券当日可否卖出"的明文条款；南非现货市场一般惯例是T+0可回转（无类似A股T+1限制的公开证据），但未找到可摘引的官方原文正面确认，按铁律留空，转 OPEN-QUESTIONS。

Equity Market_Trading & Information System_Conceptual Training_v2（clientportal.jse.co.za PDF）

short_selling.zh: 允许备兑卖空（covered short selling），禁止裸卖空（naked short selling）：客户下达卖空指令、会员向JSE交易系统录入卖空订单或报告卖空成交前，须满足证券已实际持有（非证书化形式，由会员或客户的CSDP托管）、已有另一笔交易将取得该证券、已落实借券安排、公司行动将产生该证券、或证券将从境外登记簿过户至本地登记簿等条件之一
short_selling.en: Covered short selling is permitted; naked short selling is prohibited. Before a client places a short-sell order or a member enters/reports one, the securities must be secured via one of: uncertificated holding with the member's/client's CSDP, another transaction that will yield the securities, a satisfactory borrowing arrangement, a corporate action, or transfer from a foreign register
short_selling.detail: 受控词表 short_selling_stance 的四个值（freely_allowed/restricted_uptick/restricted_list/banned）都不能干净覆盖"允许备兑、禁止裸卖空、无报升规则、无指定标的名单限制"这种规制模式——本字段因此未套用 enum，留作自由文本描述，已记入 OPEN-QUESTIONS（sa-tadawul 此前遇到同类情况但选用了 restricted_list，事后看并不精确，两案例合并记录）。

sources.title: JSE Market Notice 293/2021 — Reminder on the Prohibition of Naked Short-Selling in JSE Equities Market（PDF）

short_selling.quote: The JSE equities market rules state that clients may only place sell orders with a member (rule 10.50.1) and members may only insert sell orders into or report trades to the JSE equities trading system (rule 10.50.2) if the securities have been secured and will be available for settlement on the settlement date in one of the following circumstances: the securities are in uncertificated form, owned by the client and held by the CSDP of the member or client ... another transaction has been concluded that will yield the securities; a satisfactory borrowing arrangement is in place ...

block_trade.zh: 存在场外报告成交类别中的大宗交易（Block Trade，交易类型代码BT），可延迟至收盘后处理时段（18:15后）公布
block_trade.en: Block Trade is a defined off-book trade type (code BT); trades that would otherwise be reported after market close may be delayed and published at the start of the Post Close session

sources.title: Volume 00E – Trading and Information Overview（8.4.11/Off Book Trades）

block_trade.quote: Off Book Trades: (18:15* - 18:20*) Block Trades that are delayed such that they may result in being published after market end time (this relates to the time that End-Of-Day processes start for the day), will be published at the start of the Post Close session.

sources.title: Volume 00E – Trading and Information Overview for Equity Market v4.08（clientportal.jse.co.za PDF）
Equity Market_Trading & Information System_Conceptual Training_v2（clientportal.jse.co.za PDF）

market_maker_scheme.zh: 专项证券（ETF/AMETF/ETN/AMC/权证/结构性产品）设有做市商制度以提供流动性，是该类产品发行人获准挂牌的重要考量之一；现货股票主板/AltX普通股本身未见强制做市商要求的证据
market_maker_scheme.en: Specialist Securities (ETFs/AMETFs/ETNs/AMCs/warrants/structured products) rely on market makers for liquidity provision, a key consideration for issuers; no evidence of a mandatory market-maker requirement was found for ordinary Main Board/AltX equities

sources.title: Specialist Securities（jse.co.za）

market_maker_scheme.quote: Product issuers benefit from local and global profiling, access to capital, a broader investor base, a well-regulated market and market makers facilitating liquidity.

connect_schemes.zh: 无面向投资者的跨境互联互通机制（如沪港通模式）；但JSE的交易撮合平台（Millennium Exchange）同时承载纳米比亚证券交易所（NSX）的交易分段（ZA11/ZA12），两所共享同一撮合引擎基础设施，属技术层面的基础设施共享而非投资者准入互通
connect_schemes.en: No investor-facing cross-border connect scheme (e.g. Stock Connect-style); however, the JSE's Millennium Exchange matching platform also hosts the Namibian Stock Exchange (NSX)'s trading segments (ZA11/ZA12) — an infrastructure-sharing arrangement rather than an investor-access connect scheme

sources.title: Volume 00E – Trading and Information Overview（Market Segment table）

connect_schemes.quote: JSE (ZA01, ZA02, ZA03, ZA04, ZA06) NSX (ZA11, ZA12)

boards.target_companies: 面向已具规模的成熟企业，须委任发起人（Sponsor）
boards.financial_threshold: 最近一年税前利润至少1500万兰特且净资产（不含少数股东权益）至少5000万兰特，或净资产至少5亿兰特；须控制其资产多数权益满12个月；已发行股本至少2500万股；公众持股至少占各类别股份10%且至少100名股东

boards.target_companies: 面向成长阶段的中小型企业，须委任指定顾问（Designated Adviser, DA），业务计划须经AltX咨询委员会审议
boards.financial_threshold: 净资产（不含少数股东权益）至少200万兰特；公众持股至少占各类别股份10%；无强制利润门槛，可用经审计的上一财年报表或未来12个月盈利预测替代

review_system.zh: 以量化财务与股权分布门槛为主的交易所审核制：主板/AltX各设明确的利润、净资产、发行股数、公众持股比例等量化标准，达标申请由交易所审核后授予上市；同时保留对开发阶段公司、地产实体、矿业/油气公司、投资实体、SPAC等多类特殊申请人的例外条款与自由裁量权
review_system.en: Exchange-led review anchored in quantitative financial and shareholder-spread thresholds (profit, net asset value, issued shares, free float) for the Main Board and AltX, with the JSE granting listings to compliant applicants while retaining discretionary exemptions for development-stage companies, property entities, mining/oil & gas companies, investment entities and SPACs
review_system.detail: 受控词表 review_system（registration/approval/hybrid）三个值都不能干净覆盖这种"高度量化的交易所主导审核+大量个案例外条款"模式——继上交所/港交所/NYSE/JPX/sa-tadawul之后，这是第六个未能被现有枚举干净覆盖的真实案例，进一步印证 OPEN-QUESTIONS 第3条的判断（该字段实质已退化为自由文本描述）。

sources.title: JSE Listings Requirements Simplified（Section 2.4 Main Board）

review_system.quote: An applicant seeking a listing must have: (a) audited financial statements for the preceding three years ...; (b) (i) in respect of the most recent financial year profit of at least R15 million before tax ... and an existing net asset value*, excluding minority interests, of at least R50 million; or (ii) it must have an existing net asset value* excluding minority interests of at least R500 million; ... (d) a minimum of 25 million issued equity shares; and (e) a free float, comprising 10% of each class of equity securities held by public shareholders and representing at least 100 shareholders.

sources.title: JSE Listings Requirements Simplified（2025年12月）PDF

transfer_between_boards.zh: AltX发行人达到主板上市标准后，JSE可主动将其转板至主板，发行人亦可主动申请转板
transfer_between_boards.en: When an AltX issuer meets the Main Board listing criteria, the JSE may transfer the listing to the Main Board, or the issuer may itself apply for the transfer
transfer_between_boards.quote: when an ALTX issuer complies with the listing criteria of the main board, the JSE may transfer the listing to the main board or the issuer can make application for transfer.

sources.title: JSE Listings Requirements Simplified（2025年12月）PDF

continuing_obligations.zh: 上市公司须每年提交年度合规证明（Annual Compliance Certificate）；未按时提交的，JSE将在交易系统上以"R"标注该股票并公告提示投资者，持续未合规可能导致停牌威胁
continuing_obligations.en: Issuers must submit an Annual Compliance Certificate each year; failure to do so results in the JSE annotating the listing with an "R" flag on the trading system and issuing a cautionary announcement, with continued non-compliance risking suspension

sources.title: JSE Listings Requirements Simplified（Section 1.13）

continuing_obligations.quote: An issuer must submit an annual compliance certificate ... If the certificate is not submitted to the JSE, the JSE will on the first business day after failure to submit the certificate: (a) annotate the listing on the trading system with an "R" to indicate failure to comply; and (b) release an announcement, advising that the issuer has not provided the JSE with the certificate and cautioning holders of securities that the issuer's listing may be under threat of suspension if the certificate is not submitted to the JSE.

suspension_resumption.zh: JSE可基于不合规、双重信息、破产清算、监管机构通知/注销、停业等情形暂停证券上市；暂停后发行人须持续遵守规则、提交月度进展报告、按季度公告现状及预计复牌时间，未在合理期限内采取充分措施恢复上市条件的，JSE可进一步除牌
suspension_resumption.en: The JSE may suspend a listing on grounds including non-compliance, dual-information situations, business rescue/liquidation, regulatory deregistration notices, or ceasing business; during suspension the issuer must keep complying with the Requirements, file monthly progress reports and quarterly announcements on its status and expected resumption date — failure to take adequate remedial steps within a reasonable period allows the JSE to remove the listing

sources.title: JSE Listings Requirements Simplified（Section 1.3–1.11）

suspension_resumption.quote: If a listing is suspended and the issuer fails to take adequate steps to enable the JSE to reinstate the listing within a reasonable period, the JSE may remove the listing.

delisting_conditions.zh: JSE可在下列情形之一移除证券上市：不合规于《上市规则》；证券持有人已批准除牌（须至少75%到会表决权同意，另须提供公平意见书）；要约收购方依《公司法》第124条意图除牌；依《公司法》第114/115条完成安排计划且JSE认为发行人已不再符合上市条件；或证券按条款赎回——除牌前须先经暂停程序
delisting_conditions.en: The JSE may remove a listing where: the issuer breaches the Requirements; securities holders have approved removal (requiring at least 75% of votes cast, plus a fairness opinion); an offeror intends removal via a takeover offer under Companies Act s.124; a scheme of arrangement under ss.114/115 is completed and the JSE is satisfied the issuer no longer qualifies; or securities are redeemed per their terms — removal must first be preceded by suspension

sources.title: JSE Listings Requirements Simplified（Section 1.8–1.10）

delisting_conditions.quote: the JSE may remove the listing of securities if it will further one or more of the objects of the FMA, which may include: (a) non-compliance with the Requirements; (b) when holders of securities have approved the removal of listing ...; (c) when an offeror intends to remove a listing through a take-over offer in terms of section 124 of the Act ...; (d) on the completion of a scheme of arrangement in terms of sections 114 and 115 of the Act ... where all the securities have been acquired and the JSE is satisfied that the issuer no longer qualifies for listing; and (e) the redemption of securities in accordance with their terms, provided the listing of such securities was first suspended.

delisting_process.zh: JSE拟暂停/除牌前须依《金融市场法》第12(2)条：告知发行人拟暂停/除牌的意图、说明理由、并要求发行人在指定期限内说明不应暂停/除牌的理由（show cause）；发行人主动申请除牌则须召开股东大会，经至少75%到会表决权（不含要约方及一致行动人）通过决议，并提供公平要约与独立公平意见书
delisting_process.en: Before suspending/removing, the JSE must (under FMA s.12(2)): inform the issuer of its intention, give reasons, and call on the issuer to show cause within a specified period. A voluntary removal instead requires a general meeting resolution passed by at least 75% of votes cast (excluding the offeror and concert parties), a fair offer, and an independent fairness opinion

sources.title: JSE Listings Requirements Simplified（Section 1.10/1.12）

delisting_process.quote: When the listing of securities is under threat of suspension or removal, the JSE will, in terms of section 12(2) of the FMA: (a) inform the issuer of its intention to suspend/remove; (b) give the issuer the reasons for the intended suspension/removal; and (c) call upon the issuer to show cause, within a period specified by the JSE, why the suspension/removal should not be effected.

delisting_transition_period.detail: 未找到与A股"退市整理期"对应的固定窗口期概念——JSE的模式是"合规证明缺失即标注R+按季度公告"式的持续预警，而非固定天数的整理期，设计前提不完全对应，留空转 OPEN-QUESTIONS。

JSE Listings Requirements Simplified（2025年12月）PDF
FTSE/JSE Africa Index Series Ground Rules（v9.1，2026年2月，FTSE Russell/LSEG）

由全股指数中按可投资市值排名前40的最具投资性公司构成，成分股数量恒定为40只。

items.description: 从全股指数中筛选出符合伊斯兰教法（Shariah）的公司构成，筛选方由第三方机构Yasaar担任。

settlement_cycle.zh: T+3（2016年起，此前为T+5）：卖方交付证券换取现金（DvP），买方支付现金换取证券（RvP），经JSE指定的中央证券存管机构Strate处理，实现同步、终局、不可撤销的券款对付（SFIDvP）
settlement_cycle.en: T+3 (since 2016, down from T+5): sellers deliver securities against cash receipt (DvP) and buyers receive securities against cash payment (RvP), processed through Strate (the JSE-appointed CSD), achieving simultaneous, final, irrevocable delivery versus payment (SFIDvP)

sources.title: Equity Market Risk Management（jse.co.za，T+3结算说明页）
History | Explore the Legacy of JSE Group（group.jse.co.za，确认2016年生效日期）

settlement_cycle.quote: On T+3, settlement of cash equities transactions take place, i.e. sellers deliver securities in exchange for cash receipt (DvP), and buyers receive securities in exchange for cash payments (RvP), which is processed through the JSE appointed CSD, Strate, and which achieves simultaneous, final, irrevocable delivery versus payment (SFIDvP). ... 2014 2016 The JSE moves to a T+3 settlement cycle

ccp_name.zh: 现货证券市场无传统意义上的中央对手方净额担保安排，而是由JSE结算权威机构（JSE Settlement Authority）通过多层结算保障机制（"防线"：会员准入门槛、每日资本充足监控、CSDP承诺、保证金、违约处置流程）提供结算保障，非CCP novation模式；衍生品市场则设有独立的中央对手方JSE Clear（JSE全资子公司，2022年9月1日起持有FSCA/PA/SARB联合颁发的独立结算所与CCP牌照）
ccp_name.en: The cash equity market has no traditional CCP novation arrangement — instead, the JSE Settlement Authority provides settlement assurance through multiple "lines of defence" (membership entry requirements, daily capital-adequacy monitoring, CSDP commits, margin, default-management process). Derivatives markets instead have a dedicated CCP, JSE Clear (a wholly owned JSE subsidiary, licensed as an independent clearing house and CCP by the FSCA jointly with the PA/SARB since 1 September 2022)
ccp_name.detail: 这是本项目在 de-eurex（衍生品无"公司上市"概念）之后又一个字段设计前提与实际制度不完全吻合的案例：taxonomy 的 ccp_name 隐含假设"存在单一CCP"，但JSE现货与衍生品两个市场的清算安排结构性不同，如实分别说明比单填一个机构名更准确。

sources.title: Equity Market Risk Management（jse.co.za）
JSE Clear Granted Clearing House & CCP Licence（jse.co.za 新闻稿，2022年9月1日）

ccp_name.quote: The JSE provides settlement assurance for central order book trades in the cash equity market and employs various measures to affect this. ... JSE Clear, its wholly owned subsidiary, has been granted a licence to operate as an Independent Clearing House and Central Counterparty (CCP) by the Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) ... Published 01 Sep 2022

csd_name.zh: 证券存管中心Strate Limited，南非法定的中央证券存管机构与中央质押品平台
csd_name.en: Strate Limited, South Africa's principal central securities depository (CSD) and central collateral platform

sources.title: South Africa's principal CSD（strate.co.za）

csd_name.quote: Strate is South Africa's principal central securities depository and central collateral platform.

initial_margin_practice.zh: 针对现货证券交易的结算保障金：JSE要求会员在T+2（按T+1收盘时点计算）就其撮合成交、存在未结算风险的全部交易向JSE存入结算保证金
initial_margin_practice.en: For cash equity settlement assurance: the JSE requires members to deposit settlement margin on T+2 (calculated at the T+1 end of day) for all transactions they introduced that carry settlement risk

sources.title: Equity Market Risk Management（jse.co.za）

initial_margin_practice.quote: The JSE requires members to deposit settlement margin with the JSE on T+2 (calculated at EOD T+1) for all transactions that they have introduced to the market and which pose a risk of not settling.

delivery_method.detail: 现货证券交割为无纸化记账过户（经Strate电子结算），与该字段"实物/现金"的二分设计前提不完全对应；衍生品各品种的实物/现金交割方式本次未逐条核实，留空转 OPEN-QUESTIONS，处理方式同 sa-tadawul 的先例。

default_management.zh: JSE结算权威机构针对现货证券市场设有多层"防线"式违约处置机制：会员准入财务/资本/管理/运营门槛→每日资本充足监控（经BDA系统）→资产透明度（JSE可查会员及其客户持仓）→CSDP结算承诺→T+2结算保证金→失败交易处置流程→违约管理→治理机制，逐层降低成交无法结算的风险
default_management.en: The JSE Settlement Authority operates a multi-layered "lines of defence" default-management framework for the cash equity market: membership entry requirements, daily capital-adequacy monitoring (via the BDA system), asset visibility (the JSE can view members' and clients' holdings), CSDP settlement commits, T+2 settlement margin, a fails-transaction-management process, default management, and governance

sources.title: Equity Market Risk Management（jse.co.za）

default_management.quote: The JSE provides settlement assurance for central order book trades in the cash equity market and employs various measures to affect this. These measures are listed below: Entry Requirements Capital Adequacy View of Assets CSDP Commits Margin Fails Transaction Management Process Default Management Governance

foreign_access_channel.zh: 1995年《证券交易所管制法》修订允许境外会员在JSE开展经纪业务（历史性准入事实，当前具体境外投资者交易渠道细节本次未逐条核实）
foreign_access_channel.en: A 1995 amendment to the Stock Exchange Control Act permitted foreign members to operate on the JSE (a historical admission fact; current-state details of foreign investor access channels were not individually verified this round)

sources.title: History | Explore the Legacy of JSE Group（group.jse.co.za）

foreign_access_channel.quote: Amendment of the Stock Exchange Control Act of 1985 The amendment allowed for the introduction of corporate and qualified membership. Corporate broking membership with limited liability was introduced. Member firms were to be the trading entity and not the individual. Foreign members were allowed to operate.

membership_structure.zh: 交易会员须满足财务、资本、管理与运营等最低会员资格要求，并须委任结算主管及候补结算主管协助JSE结算权威机构处理结算事务；会员通过Broker Dealer Accounting（BDA）系统向JSE报告资本充足状况
membership_structure.en: Trading members must meet minimum membership requirements (financial, capital, management and operational) and appoint a settlement officer and an alternate settlement officer to assist the JSE Settlement Authority; members report capital adequacy to the JSE via the Broker Dealer Accounting (BDA) system

sources.title: Equity Market Risk Management（jse.co.za）

membership_structure.quote: All trading members need to comply with the minimum membership requirements which include financial, capital, management and operational requirements and the appointment of a settlement officer and an alternate settlement officer to assist the JSE Settlement Authority in terms of managing settlement issues.

trading_system_name.zh: Millennium Exchange（由技术方案商MillenniumIT开发），2012年现货权益市场率先迁移，2019年权益及货币衍生品迁移接入；此前曾使用TradElect平台
trading_system_name.en: Millennium Exchange (developed by MillenniumIT); the cash equity market moved onto it in 2012, with equity and currency derivatives following in 2019; the prior platform was TradElect

sources.title: History | Explore the Legacy of JSE Group（group.jse.co.za）

trading_system_name.quote: 2009 2012 The JSE's Equity Market moves to a new trading platform The JSE launched a new trading platform Millennium Exchange, developed by technology solutions provider MillenniumIT. The move from the previous TradElect platform followed extensive testing and consultation with stakeholders. ... 2016 2019 JSE migrates equity and currency derivatives to Millennium Exchange

access_methods.zh: 提供托管接入服务（Colocation Centre，2014年启用），允许客户将交易设备部署在JSE机房以获得低延迟接入
access_methods.en: Offers a colocation centre (opened 2014), allowing clients to place trading equipment at the JSE for low-latency access

sources.title: History | Explore the Legacy of JSE Group（group.jse.co.za）

access_methods.quote: 2012 2014 The JSE opens its colocation centre The colocation centre allows clients to place their trading equipment at the JSE to allow for fast access to all markets.

stamp_duty.zh: 证券转让税（Securities Transfer Tax，STT）：税率0.25%，适用于上市与未上市证券的每一次转让，2008年7月1日起依《证券转让税法》（No.25 of 2007）及其征管法（No.26 of 2007）施行，取代原印花税制度
stamp_duty.en: Securities Transfer Tax (STT): levied at 0.25% on every transfer of a security (listed or unlisted), effective 1 July 2008 under the Securities Transfer Tax Act No. 25 of 2007 and its Administration Act No. 26 of 2007, replacing the former stamp duty regime
stamp_duty.detail: 南非现行税种法定名称为"证券转让税"而非"印花税"，性质对应本项目 stamp_duty 字段（证券转让环节的交易税），非另设的 financial_transaction_tax。

sources.title: Securities Transfer Tax（sars.gov.za）

stamp_duty.quote: Securities Transfer Tax is levied on every transfer of a security and was implemented from 1 July 2008 under the Securities Transfer Tax Act, No. 25 of 2007, together with the Securities Transfer Tax Administration Act, No. 26 of 2007. ... Securities tax is levied at the rate of 0,25%.

financial_transaction_tax.detail: 南非证券交易环节的税负由 stamp_duty 字段的证券转让税（STT）覆盖，未见另设独立的金融交易税，故本字段留空而非重复记录。

dividend_withholding_tax.zh: 股息预扣税税率20%（自2017年2月22日起由15%上调），除非适用豁免或双重征税协定下的优惠税率
dividend_withholding_tax.en: Dividends Tax (dividend withholding tax) at 20%, increased from 15% for dividends paid on or after 22 February 2017, unless an exemption or a reduced treaty rate applies

sources.title: Dividends Tax（sars.gov.za）

dividend_withholding_tax.quote: The rate of Dividends Tax increased from 15% to 20% for any dividend paid on or after 22 February 2017 (irrespective of declaration date), unless an exemption or reduced rate is applicable.

fx_risk_note.zh: 南非兰特为自由浮动汇率制度，历史波动性相对新兴市场货币偏高（一般性背景认知，本次未附一手原文来源核实具体波动数据，confidence相应降级）
